messages.Segment list colours: green/amber/red te: Segment list colours: green/amber/red text is the model's confidence (high/medium/low). An orange row background means its timing overlaps the previous segment or is under 1s (usually after a manual 'Edit timestamp...' edit). A yellow highlight marks the segment now playing.
